piece.idea: Meta staff were ranked by AI use. They gamed it.
piece.thesis: Staff judged by how much AI they used used more of it, much of it on nothing. A rat bounty in Hanoi in 1902 shows why a count becomes the goal.
piece.body: At some of the biggest companies in tech, staff were judged, and then ranked, by how much AI they used.
